fine_lines.title: take a bite vs take a sip
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Bite" is for food (with teeth). "Sip" is for drinks (a small amount).

examples.sentence: He took a bite of the hot dog.
He took a sip of the cappuccino.

fine_lines.title: remind vs remember
fine_lines.explanation_ar: remember = أنت تتذكر. remind = شيء يجعلك تتذكر. نقول: It reminds me of ... ولا نقول It remembers me.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Remember" = you think of the past. "Remind" = something makes you remember. Say "It reminds me of ...", not "It remembers me".

examples.sentence: This food reminds me of my mother.
I remember my first day at school.

expressions.phrase: Why does everything have to go wrong today?
expressions.meaning_ar: لماذا يجب أن يسوء كل شيء اليوم؟
expressions.example: My bus is late and it's raining. Why does everything go wrong today?
The red bag caught my eye.
Do you want any toppings on your pizza?

expressions.meaning_en: Answering when someone likes your food.
expressions.example: "This cake is great!" "Glad you like it."

expressions.phrase: You really know how to make fried chicken.
expressions.meaning_ar: أنت حقًا تعرف كيف تصنع الدجاج المقلي.
expressions.example: You really know how to make good tea!
You passed the test? That's great to hear.

expressions.phrase: Maybe today wasn't so bad after all.
expressions.meaning_ar: ربما لم يكن اليوم سيئًا إلى هذا الحد في النهاية.
expressions.example: The trip wasn't so bad after all.

expressions.phrase: A little treat can go a long way.
expressions.meaning_ar: شيء صغير لطيف قد يُحدث فرقًا كبيرًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Small nice things help a lot.
expressions.example: A kind word can go a long way.

grammar.title: Past simple in a story
grammar.explanation_ar: القصص تُحكى بالماضي البسيط. أفعال منتظمة تنتهي بـ ed (walked, decided) وأفعال شاذة (saw, took, felt, lost, caught).
grammar.explanation_en: Stories use the past simple. Regular verbs end in -ed; irregular verbs change.
examples: He took a bite and felt better.

grammar.title: remind someone of something
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل remind يأتي بعده شخص ثم of ثم الشيء: It reminds me of happy times.
examples: The hot dog reminds me of happy times.
This smell reminds me of my grandmother's kitchen.
It reminded him of a trip to Japan.
